subject: Expansion follow-up: volume validation, blended rate scenarios & route add
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chan <alyssa@brightnovel.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + ask: monthly token ranges & budget target

Hi Alyssa — thanks for a productive call earlier. Quick recap and a few asks so we can put together concrete blended-rate options and an MAP: 

Call highlights
- Current production traffic: preview feature for 150k monthly active users; ~50k calls/day (spike to 80k).
- Two major routes: customer-facing chat (mostly base LLM) and a smaller code-assist route for power users.
- Renewal coming up in Q3; looking to expand to include code-gen route and embeddings for search.

What we need from you to model pricing:
1) Monthly token ranges (best-effort): low / expected / high (tokens per month) for next 12 months.
2) Target budget range for inference (monthly) or target $/1M tokens you want us to aim for.
3) Any constraints on model families (e.g., must avoid internal-only models) or regulatory constraints.

Attached: BrightNovel-MAP-v2.xlsx (MVP timeline) and a draft "blend scenarios" PDF with sample blended $/1M outcomes based on route mix. If you can reply with the token ranges (or the rough conversion from calls->tokens), we’ll send 2 blended proposals: one for a conservative 1–3M tokens/mo and one for steady-state 3–10M tokens/mo including step-up discounts and route add pricing.

Next steps
- You: share token ranges + procurement contact (if different).
- Us: produce two blended-rate scenarios and a suggested rollout (trial route add, then expand).
- Aim to have draft pricing and MAP ready by Friday 7/23.

Thanks — Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: BrightNovel-MAP-v2.xlsx, redwood-blend-scenarios.pdf
From: Alyssa Chan <alyssa@brightnovel.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightNovel Procurement <procurement@brightnovel.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: monthly token ranges & budget target

Thanks, Logan — good summary. Quick answers inline:

Token estimates (best-effort)
- Low: 1.2M tokens/mo (pilot, limited users)
- Expected: 4.5M tokens/mo (6–8 weeks after rollout)
- High: 9–12M tokens/mo (full push + marketing)

Budget target
- We’re aiming for a ballpark of $8k–$12k / month for inference initially; translate that however you need to $/1M tokens. Procurement looped in for PO timing.

Routes & constraints
- Chat route will be majority (80% of tokens).
- Code-assist route is ~5–10% of tokens but drives value; interested in routing to an optimized code model if economics make sense.
- We need data residency in US only.

I attached the usage estimate spreadsheet we use internally. Let me know if you want a quick calibration call with our engineering lead (Sam).

—Alyssa
Alyssa Chan
Head of Product, BrightNovel
alyssa@brightnovel.com | +1 (212) 555-4490

Attachment: BrightNovel_usage_estimate.xlsx
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chan <alyssa@brightnovel.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: monthly token ranges & budget target

Appreciate the numbers — that helps a lot. Quick read + proposed next steps: 

Interpretation
- Expected steady state ~4.5M tokens/mo -> budget target $8k–$12k/mo implies target unit economics roughly $1.8k–$2.7k per 1M tokens (this is a raw conversion; will refine once we model route mix and quantization).
- Because chat is ~80% of tokens, a blended rate that weights cheaper base model pricing more heavily will reduce $/1M. Adding code-gen route (higher $/1M) will raise blended cost unless volume grows.

What we’ll send you (by EOD 7/23)
- Two blended scenarios: conservative (1–3M) and expansion (3–10M) with step-up breaks at 1M, 3M, 5M and 10M.
- Route-add pricing for code-assist + an embeddings price sheet.
- A recommended initial rollout: enable code route as a trial on 5% of traffic for 30 days, measure token ratio & quality, then scale.

Requests for internal ops (Ben/Monica)
- Ben: can you run a quick blended calc using the BrightNovel usage sheet and give target $/1M bands (1M, 3M, 5M)? I’ve attached Alyssa’s spreadsheet.
- Monica: can you prepare a short MAP excerpt for procurement that outlines PO timing and trial acceptance criteria.

Alyssa — want to confirm: is procurement the correct PO contact? If so, I’ll include a draft addendum that shows the step-up pricing table and a 30-day trial clause.

Thanks — L

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion follow-up: volume validation, blended rate scenarios & route add

Quick take from pricing ops:
- If expected steady-state is 4.5M/mo and budget is $8k–$12k/mo, that implies an effective target between ~$1.8k–$2.7k per 1M tokens. That’s clearly below our standard hosted pricing for mixed base+code models, so we need to propose blended discounts + a small commitment.

Suggested bands (preliminary)
- 1M band: $3,500 / 1M tokens
- 3M band: $2,200 / 1M tokens
- 5M band: $1,500 / 1M tokens
- 10M+ band: $1,050 / 1M tokens

Blend example (4.5M / mo with 80/20 chat/code split)
- Chat (3.6M) @ base model price -> effective $/1M = $1,800
- Code (0.9M) @ code model price -> effective $/1M = $4,500
- Weighted blended ≈ $2,040 / 1M tokens -> ~$9.2k / month

Notes
- To hit their $8k upper target we would need either additional volume commitments (3–5M sustained) or to offer an introductory trial discount for first 2 months.
- We can support a route-add for code-assist; recommend trial discount of 25% on code route for 30 days to prove ROI.

I’ll produce a simple calc sheet and drop it in the shared Drive (pricing calc + assumptions).

—Ben
Director, Pricing & GTM Economics
ben_carter@redwood.com

If we get answers to the three items above today, we can have the formal addendum and MAP in DocuSign by Monday 7/26.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to moving this to trial.

Regards,
